credits.title: Black Coffee
credits.overview: In the Gayo Highlands of Aceh, Onot and Rabiah, a blind couple, live from their small coffee plantation. Their days move through touch, memory, and routine, shaping a life of dignity and independence while sharing a deep longing for a child. credits.title: Leaf on a Pillow
credits.overview: The Indonesian society is seen through a middle-aged lady's eyes in her daily encounters with the street children who work and live off the harsh and sleazy world of adults.
